press_references.value: Mixpanel Introduces Mixpanel AI, Delivering Always-On Product Intelligence

product_launches.description: Mixpanel launched Mixpanel AI, an always-on product intelligence system with autonomous agents, a Context Engine, and integrations with tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Slack to help teams analyze product usage and act on insights.

press_references.value: Mixpanel Launches Metric Trees, a Dynamic In-Platform Capability That Connects Every KPI to Business Impact

product_launches.description: Mixpanel has launched Metric Trees, a new digital analytics capability that provides dynamic, hierarchical views of KPIs and their business impact, enabling teams to move from reactive analysis to proactive strategy.

press_references.value: Mixpanel Expands Digital Analytics Platform to Power Continuous Innovation at Scale

product_launches.description: Mixpanel announced a major expansion of its digital analytics platform, introducing new capabilities such as experimentation, session replay, AI-powered insights, metric trees, and enhanced warehouse integrations. These features aim to help teams make faster, data-driven decisions and optimize digital experiences.

press_references.value: Behavioral Analytics Market to Reach USD 6,116.18 Million by 2032 Driven by AI Integration and Rising Cybersecurity Demand - Credence Research

product_launches.description: Mixpanel expanded its analytics suite in June 2025 with AI-powered automation, experimentation tools, and qualitative insights.

overview_description.description: Mixpanel helps companies measure what matters, make decisions fast, and build better products through data. The company offers a self-serve product analytics solution that can analyze how and why people engage, convert, and retain in real-time across devices to improve their user experience. It turns data into decisions with analytics that simplify answers, guide decisions, and measure the impact of product and marketing investments.

about_short_description.short_description: Mixpanel turns data into decisions with analytics that simplify insights, guide decisions, and measure product and marketing impact.

product.name: Mixpanel Product Analytics
product.description: Cloud-based behavioral analytics for understanding how users engage with digital products through funnels, retention, cohorts, segmentation, paths, and other event-based analyses.

product.name: Mixpanel Experiments & Feature Flagging
product.description: An experimentation and controlled-release platform for testing product changes, managing feature rollouts, and measuring effects on conversion, engagement, retention, and revenue.

product.name: Mixpanel Session Replay
product.description: A qualitative analytics capability that records and replays user sessions and provides heatmaps to help teams locate friction in web and mobile experiences.

product.name: Mixpanel Web Analytics
product.description: Analytics for website traffic, navigation, acquisition, and conversion, helping teams understand visitor behavior and identify points of drop-off.

product.name: Mixpanel Mobile Analytics
product.description: Behavioral analytics for iOS and Android applications, covering app journeys, sessions, feature usage, engagement, and user retention.

product.name: Mixpanel AI
product.description: AI-assisted product intelligence that uses verified behavioral data and business context to answer product questions, surface insights, summarize findings, and support analytics workflows.
